headline: Chelsea 2-2 Hull: Belloumi twice, and the clean sheet is gone
whyCareReason: Hull had not conceded in three league games. They scored twice at Stamford Bridge and still left with a point.
teaser: Rogers 7', Pedro 66'; Bachir Belloumi 28', 34'. Hull unbeaten. Chelsea on 7.
story:
Why this one matters: Hull City arrived at Stamford Bridge with seven points and no goals conceded. They left with eight points and two goals conceded, and they scored twice themselves.

Football Web Pages: Morgan Rogers 7', Joao Pedro 66' for Chelsea. Bachir Belloumi 28' and 34' for Hull. Attendance 39,352. Match XI and Squawka both put Hull third on 8 points after the draw.

The Tigers are still unbeaten. The clean sheet that survived United, Villa and matchweek 3 did not survive London. That is still a sentence the table has to live with.
stakes: A promoted side's unbeaten start against a side that had already lost in north London.
rivalryAngle: New money versus a club that was supposed to be the measuring stick.
